name: Oath of Moment: Panoply of Old (Ultramarines)
description: Though every Blackshield has cast away the oaths that once bound them, some retained the wargear of their Legion. These relics of the Great Crusade would no longer be used to fight for the glory of the Primarchs, but for the bitter grudges of the cast-out. A Unit that includes Models with this Special Rule may make use of Wargear upgrades from a single Legion Armoury. For each Detachment with this Oath of Moment, the Controlling Player must select a single Legion Trait. All Units in that Detachment may make use of any Armoury of the Legion Wargear upgrades. This does not include any Rules or options from the chosen Legion’s Rites of War or any Prime Advantages – only options which replace Wargear. For the purposes of selecting Wargear upgrades only, all Models in the Detachment for which this Oath of Moment is selected are considered to have the Faction Trait of Legion chosen as part of this Oath of Moment. Legion chosen: Ultramarines. Options a Legion adds to the shared Legion wargear lists are not included.

argyrum-pattern-boarding-shield.name: Argyrum Pattern Boarding Shield
argyrum-pattern-boarding-shield.text: This Wargear provides an enhanced save against attacks made in close combat. Any Model with the Command or Champion Sub-Type and the Ultramarines Trait have one Argyrum pattern boarding shield selected for it for +15 Points per Model. A Model with a Argyrum pattern boarding shield has a 5+ Invulnerable Save, increasing to a 4+ Invulnerable Save against Wounds inflicted by Melee Weapons. In addition, it gains the Shield Trait and the Heavy Sub-Type.

ultramarines-legatine-axe.name: Legatine Axe
ultramarines-legatine-axe.description: Any Model with the Command, Champion or Sergeant Sub-Type and the Ultramarines Trait may have its power axe exchanged for one Legatine axe.
